note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 5176 Section 2.2 and HEAD code (coa.go answerRequest). TestRFC5176UnsupportedServiceTypeValueIsNAKed sends Service-Type 1, 2, 6 and 8 in valid CoA-Requests over UDP and asserts CoA-NAK, Error-Cause strictly [405] and zero bus events. TestRFC5176CoAWithoutServiceTypeIsACKed sends the identical request without Service-Type and asserts CoA-ACK, no Error-Cause and one rate-change event. Both MUST (CoA-NAK) and SHOULD (405) are isolated and fail if Service-Type refusal breaks.
